jobs.title: Director, Denominational Property Strategy
jobs.description:
**The United Church of Canada is seeking an individual to fill the role of Director, Denominational Property Strategy on a full\-time basis (35 hours/week) for a 2\-year contract, with potential for renewal.** This position represents a new position within our organization.



All applications received through The United Church of Canada’s Applicant Tracking System (ATS) for all publicly advertised positions, AI might be used to support certain applicant evaluations however, all applications are manually reviewed by our hiring team to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all candidates. All decisions are made solely by the hiring team.


The position oversees a Property Resource Group located in the Organizational Development and Strategy (ODS) Unit. The ODS Unit supports the General Council Office in the development, execution, and communication of its vision and strategic priorities. It provides enterprise\-wide leadership for the direction, alignment, and execution of the Church’s national strategy and programmatic work.


The Unit establishes strategic priorities, sets expectations for outcomes and accountability, and ensures that programmatic initiatives across the Church are aligned, integrated, and effectively resourced. It serves as the central coordinating body for organizational planning and execution, enabling coherence across diverse ministries, regions, and functions.


Partnering with regional councils, a key responsibility of the Unit is the leadership and implementation of a comprehensive denomination\-wide property strategy. Together we are striving to ensure that property assets are stewarded in alignment with ministry priorities, financial sustainability, and long\-term needs. Property Resource Group within the Unit supports region and and congregations towards integrating property considerations into broader strategic and programmatic planning.


### **Position Purpose**

The Director, Denominational Property Strategy provides senior leadership for the development and implementation of a country\-wide property strategy, within the polity of The United Church of Canada. While property is a key area of regional oversight, there is also an expectation of developing a more proactive, coordinated and strategic approach to support ministry needs, steward assets and contribute to long\-term financial sustainability. This includes aligning property decisions with strategic priorities and helping enhance coordinated approaches across regions. Operating primarily through influence, coordination, and relationship building, the Director works collaboratively with Regional Councils, Kindred Works, Regional Extension Councils, housing societies, congregations, and other key stakeholders to foster alignment, build consensus, and ensure coherence across the denominational property ecosystem


The position is accountable for the development and stewardship of this strategy as well as providing a key coordinating and support function related to implementation of focused priorities, enhanced policy coherence, proactive engagement, and risk mitigation. The strategy implementation, in conjunction with regions, helps resources be aligned with the Church’s call and long\-term vision.


### **Primary areas of responsibility:**

* **Denominational Property Strategy:** Provide leadership in the development of a denomination\-wide property strategy in collaboration with Regional Councils, supporting alignment with the Church’s Call, Vision, and strategic priorities; Translate strategic priorities; Monitor progress, evaluate outcomes; Support policy development and foster proactive strategic property stewardship.
* **Leadership and Advice**: Lead consultation and engagement processes to gather input to inform strategic decision\-making; Build organizational capacity; Support and enable Regional Councils in their property oversight role by offering guidance; Support efforts across the church to provide congregational services as communities of faith explore options to make faithful and prudent decisions regarding their buildings. Direct the work of the Property Resource Group.
* **Resources, Data and Systems:** Oversee resource development and training strategies to share and support property best practices, including governance capacity building; Promote the development and use of reliable property data, analytics, and reporting to inform strategic decisions; Track and propose possible streams of revenue and sources of funding related to the church property sector.


* **Stakeholder Engagement**: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders including Communities of Faith, Regional Councils, Kindred Works Inc., Extension Councils and other key stakeholders; Function as a key liaison to relevant church adjacent property entities, including Kindred Works and regional extension councils; Contribute a denominational voice at tables with potential not\-for\-profit and government partners.
* To request a copy of the full job description, send an e\-mail to: careers@united\-church.ca and put Director, Denominational Property on the subject line

### **Qualifications**


* **A graduate degree in Business Administration (MBA), Real Estate, Urban Planning, Finance, Law, project management or a related field is required;**
* Professional designations or certificates in real estate, planning or asset management (ie: AACI, CPM, RPA or equivalent) are considered an asset.

jobs.title: Analytics Associate Director, US Oncology
jobs.description:
**Location** Mississauga, Ontario, Canada **Job ID** R\-260958 **Date posted** 30/09/2026
  
Are you ready to turn complex data into insights that shape oncology strategy and improve commercial performance? As Associate Director, Analytics, U.S. Oncology, you will lead commercial analytics within the U.S. Oncology portfolio, helping teams maximize inline brands and prepare for new launches. You will partner with Marketing and cross\-functional colleagues to frame critical business questions and deliver innovative, evidence\-based answers in collaboration with Market Research, Data Science, Forecasting, Finance, Market Access, and Data Management.


**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------


* Partner with stakeholders to define strategic business questions, align priorities, and translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Lead advanced analytics using complex internal and external healthcare data to evaluate brand performance drivers, disease states, patient journeys, and customer behavior.
* Serve as a data and analytics expert, ensuring appropriate methods, data interpretation, quality, governance, and compliance while advancing innovative tools and best practices.
* Scope, prioritize, and manage multiple analytics projects, balancing business value, timelines, resources, risks, and delivery by internal teams and external agencies.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships, communicate insights effectively to senior leaders, and coach junior analytics colleagues to strengthen collaboration and delivery quality.

This role reports to the Franchise Analytics Director and sits within the Analytics, Data \& Reporting function in U.S. Oncology Business Excellence department. The team partners with the U.S. Oncology commercial organization to improve strategic and operational decisions through objective insights, analytics, and performance reporting.


This position is based in Canada.


**Essential Skills and****Experience**
--------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree with a preference for a quantitative field.
* At least 5 years of experience in analytics, statistics, or a related field, including at least 3 years in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or biopharmaceutical consulting sector.
* At least 5 years of experience analyzing large, complex healthcare datasets, including claims and electronic health record data.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical plans and decision\-ready recommendations.
* Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to stakeholders.
* At least 2 years of experience providing day\-to\-day direction to internal or external analytics team members.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------


* Advanced degree in a quantitative, scientific, or business discipline.
* Commercial analytics experience within oncology.
* Experience with predictive modeling, machine learning, or other advanced analytical methods.
* Proficiency in SQL, R, Python, or comparable analytical tools.
* Experience overseeing business intelligence and data visualization solutions.
* Proven project leadership skills, including prioritization, resource coordination, and risk management.

Working at AstraZeneca


When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we spark bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace, and challenge perceptions.


That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual local flexibility.


**Why AstraZeneca?**


At AstraZeneca's Oncology Business Unit, we are fundamentally changing the way cancer is treated through innovation. We turn our pipeline into reality for more patients, bringing novel and transformative medicines to market. Our pipeline is one of the deepest and broadest in the industry, with innovative science and life\-changing medicines to work on today and in the future. We believe in co\-creation, harnessing our diverse strengths, and sharing best practices to build the future of our business and industry together. Ready to make your mark on the healthcare ecosystem? and join us in building the next wave of Oncology!


**⠀**


Annual base salary for this position ranges from 134,708\.00 to 176,804\.25\.
AstraZeneca is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The range provided in this posting represents an offer pay range used in a majority of situations. The base pay offered will vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, and other specific business and organizational needs. In some cases, offers outside the range may also be considered to address unique circumstances.


In addition, our permanent positions offer an annual Variable Pay Bonus/Short Term Incentive opportunity as well as eligibility to participate in our equity\-based long\-term incentive program (if applicable to role). Benefits offered for permanent roles include a competitive Flex Benefits \& Retirement Savings Program, 4 weeks’ paid vacation, and annual Personal Days. Fixed Term Contract/Temporary positions (excluding students) are offered a Contract Benefits Program.


We are using AI as part of the recruitment process.


This advertisement relates to a current vacancy.

jobs.title: AVP Dealer Transformation
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

**Shape the Future of Wealth Management**

Sun Life is seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking **AVP, Dealer Transformation** to lead the evolution of our Retail Wealth Platform and transformation strategy. This executive role will define and execute a multi\-year roadmap that enhances advisor and client experiences, accelerates digital innovation, improves operational efficiency, and supports the future growth of our wealth business.


As a key member of the Dealer Leadership Team, you will serve as a business platform owner, partnering across Distribution, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Risk, and Product teams to deliver meaningful business outcomes and position Sun Life for the future of wealth management.  



  

**What Will you do?**

* Develop and execute the Retail Wealth Platform strategy and transformation roadmap.
* Lead enterprise\-wide initiatives that modernize advisor and client experiences.
* Drive digital, data, automation, and AI\-enabled capabilities across the dealer.
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify processes, improve scalability, and increase operational efficiency.
* Partner with business leaders to build capabilities that support advisor growth and business expansion.
* Provide strategic leadership on technology modernization and platform evolution.
* Translate regulatory and industry changes into practical business solutions.
Influence and align senior stakeholders to successfully deliver complex transformation initiatives.  
* 

  

**What do you need to succeed?**

* Senior leadership experience in wealth management, financial services, consulting, or business transformation.
* Strong understanding of the Canadian wealth management and advisor ecosystem.
* Proven track record leading large\-scale business transformation initiatives.
* Experience developing strategic roadmaps and delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Expertise in digital transformation, automation, data, AI, and platform modernization.
* Strong business and financial acumen with experience building business cases and assessing investment opportunities.
* Knowledge of Canadian securities regulations and dealer operations.
Exceptional executive communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.  
* 

  

**Why Join Sun Life?**

This is a unique opportunity to lead one of the most significant transformation mandates within Sun Life Wealth, helping shape the future advisor and client experience while driving growth, innovation, and operational excellence across the business.


**If you're a strategic transformation leader who thrives on building the future, we'd love to hear from you.**

  

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.  



  

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.  



  

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e\-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com .  



  

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.  



  

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.  



  

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.  



  

**Salary Range:**

155,000/155 000 \- 225,000/225 000
**Job Category:**

Sales \- Distribution Support

jobs.title: Workforce Strategy & Talent Development Director (HRBP)
jobs.description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

Workforce Strategy\& Talent Development Director (HRBP)
  
  

Your Impact
  
Shape the future of the organization through workforce, talent, and organizational strategy. As a Workforce Strategy\& Talent Development Director, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, influencing critical business decisions, driving global workforce transformation, strengthening leadership capability, and delivering people strategies that accelerate business performance. You’ll lead workforce planning, organization design, talent strategy, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives while tackling complex challenges and delivering meaningful, measurable business impact.
  
  

This is an individual contributor role requiring five days per week onsite, offering the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders and colleagues across the organization.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
  

* Partner with senior leaders to align people strategies with business priorities and organizational needs.
* Lead global workforce planning, organization design, talent strategy, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
* Provide executive coaching, consultation, and trusted counsel to leaders, influencing decisions and constructively challenging thinking when needed.
* Drive organizational transformation and change initiatives from planning through execution.
* Use workforce and talent analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Lead complex, cross\-functional people initiatives with strong program and stakeholder management discipline.
* Drive alignment and consistency on function\-specific priorities and global HR programs across all regions.
* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and HR Shared Services, to deliver integrated solutions and talent advisory to business leaders.


What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Senior and executive leaders see you as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.
* Business strategy, workforce plans, and talent priorities are strongly aligned.
* Leadership pipelines are strengthened and succession plans are robust and future\-ready.
* Organizational changes and transformation initiatives are delivered effectively and on schedule.
* Complex people initiatives are managed with clear governance, milestones, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
* Risks and dependencies are anticipated early, enabling faster, better\-informed decisions.
* Workforce and talent insights translate into recommendations that improve business performance and organizational effectiveness.
* Strong collaboration and alignment across the HR team and broader organization.


What It Takes
  
  

* Significant HR Business Partner experience supporting senior and executive leaders in complex, global organizations.
* Expertise in workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and organizational design.
* Strong business acumen, executive presence, and consulting capability.
* Ability to coach, influence, and constructively challenge leaders.
* Experience leading large\-scale transformation, organizational change, and strategic initiatives.
* Strong project and program management skills, including planning, prioritization, stakeholder management, governance, and execution.
* Ability to connect strategy to action and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Enterprise mindset with strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills.


One Last Thing
  
If you’re ready to shape the workforce, develop talent, and help drive meaningful organizational changes, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and help shape the organization, the talent, and the future of the business.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Blossom Group (Blooming Acres \& Apple Blossom Village) provides specialized residential care and support for individuals with complex developmental, behavioural, and mental health needs. We are seeking a collaborative **Director of Finance** to lead financial operations and strengthen the systems that support high\-quality, trauma\-informed care.

Blossom Group is a CARE based organization that provides therapeutic live in programs, we support children, youth, and adults through a range of cognitive, social, and emotional issues, including Autism Spectrum Disorders, neurobiological and developmental disabilities, and those with coexisting mental health and behavioural issues. We strive to improve health outcomes by supporting clients through personalized, accessible healthcare solutions

* **Our vision is a world that embraces people with complex special needs.**
* **Our mission is to create supportive nurturing communities that enable residents to develop to their maximum potential and enjoy an exceptional quality of life.**
* **To achieve our vision and mission we strive for excellence in every aspect of care and create individualized programs that are developmentally focused, family involved, relationship based, competence centered, trauma informed, and ecologically oriented.**

**The Role**

The Director of Finance, reporting to the Chief Operations Officer, will lead the finance team and oversee financial operations, purchasing, vendor relationships, and asset acquisition. Working closely with the Chief Operations Officer, this role will align financial and operational systems with the needs of our clients, staff, and programs.

The organization partners with an external accounting firm for financial statement preparation and specialized accounting support. The Director of Finance will work closely with these partners while leveraging internal reporting and AI\-supported tools to enhance financial analysis and decision\-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the finance team, setting clear priorities, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Oversee accounts payable and receivable, billing, collections, payments, and cash requirements.
* Work with Payroll and Human Resources to review and approve accurate, timely payroll.
* Support budget development, spending oversight, financial policies, and internal controls.
* Manage vendor relationships and negotiate pricing, payment terms, and service agreements.
* Coordinate equipment, technology, furnishings, vehicle, and other asset purchases for staff and programs.
* Collaborate with the COO and program leaders to improve financial and operational processes.
* Work with the Senior AI and Business Transformation team on automation, reporting, and system improvements.
* Coordinate documentation for funders, external accountants, and audits, and address financial concerns promptly.
* Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support organizational growth and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and monitor key financial performance indicators.
* Present financial information and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify financial risks and opportunities and implement mitigation strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Relevant post\-secondary education or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, or financial operations.
* Minimum 2 years of leadership experience managing staff or teams.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, cash flow, payroll, purchasing, accounts payable and receivable, and internal controls.
* Experience with vendor negotiations and relationship management.
* Strong organizational, communication, and collaborative problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency with financial software, Excel, and digital systems, including the ability to use AI\-supported tools.
* Experience in developmental services, residential care, or health care is an asset.
* CPA designation is an asset, but is not required.

**Blossom Group Supports the Ontario Immigration Program (PNP).**

**\*\*\*QUALIFIED APPLICANTS MUST HOLD APPROPRIATE DOCUMENTS PERMITTING THEM TO RESIDE AND WORK IN CANADA\*\*\***

*Blossom Group is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all applicants. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation during the application process, please contact hr@blossomgroup.ca*.

We use automated tools, including artificial intelligence systems, to support our recruitment process. These tools may include email automation and transcription analysis to assist in screening and assessing applications. All decisions are reviewed by our hiring team.

Pay: $85,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* Extended health care
* On\-site parking
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Minesing, ON
